Reuse that issue; do not import POSIX loader/build/compiler assumptions or claim host/target performance from source.

commit_title: feat: initial gate module - noise gate and downward expander
rationale: Initial ARM64 Gate/Expand plugin uses stereo peak following, hysteresis, attack/hold/release and float/log/exp arithmetic to attenuate low-level material. A master noise gate would alter intentional soft notes and FX tails, not provide a sound-preserving resource optimization. No demonstrated native noise-gating need or matching bug justifies a new issue; plugin loader/release metadata is platform-specific.
